info.title: Mentio API
info.description: Keyword and brand mention tracking across dev platforms.

bearerAuth.description: API key minted via POST /v1/api-keys (format mk_live_...)

muted.description: Not polled or matched. Either paused by you or by the wallet (see pausedForBalance).

pausedForBalance.description: Muted by the wallet for lack of balance; a top-up resumes it, unmuting by hand needs balance too.

platforms.description: Platforms this keyword is tracked on; null means every platform.

mentions.description: Every match ever, relevant or not: the number billing counts.

relevant.description: Matches scored at or above the relevance threshold.

last7d.description: Matches published in the last 7 days.

lastMentionAt.description: Newest matched post; null until the first one.

platform.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin.

lastPolledAt.description: Newest poll of this platform for the term; null until the first one.

emptyPolls.description: Consecutive polls that found nothing new; the scheduler slows down as it grows.

polling.description: Poll health per platform polled on a schedule. Live feeds (Bluesky) have no entry.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code; branch on this, never on the message. Codes are additive: a client should treat one it does not know as a generic failure of the same status.

message.description: Human-readable detail; may change between releases.

requestId.description: The id of this request (also the X-Request-Id response header); quote it to support.

retryAfterSeconds.description: For rate_limited and other retryable errors: how long to wait before retrying (mirrors the Retry-After header).

id.description: Mention id (mm_...): one post matched to one of your keywords. A post matching two keywords has two ids.

status.description: open: nobody handled it yet. ignored: hidden from the feed and channels by you. done: handled.

relevant.description: The classifier scored it at or above the delivery threshold (40).

delivered.description: Reached at least one of your channels.

priority.description: Attention score, one decimal, computed at read time: relevance halved, author reach on a follower ladder (unknown reach counts 8), the strongest intent (buy intent 20 down to praise 5), minus 2 per day of age floored at 20.

platform.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin.

text.description: Title and body, truncated to 8 KB at ingest.

links.description: Links the post carries, in the order written, at most 20. Empty for a post with none, and for posts ingested before September 2026.

author.description: Parent post author as the platform names them.

text.description: Parent post text, when the platform gave it.

replyTo.description: The post this one replies to (X, Bluesky); null for top-level posts.

id.description: Person id (aut_...) for GET /v1/people/{id}; null when the account is not in the audience yet.

name.description: Display name as the platform reports it.

handle.description: Platform handle derived from the profile URL, formatted as the platform shows it (@name, u/name); null where the platform has none.

avatarUrl.description: Profile picture; null where the platform has none.

followers.description: Follower count as of their newest post; null where the platform has none.

tags.description: Your workspace tags on this person.

author.description: Who posted it; null when the platform gave no author at all.

relevance.description: 0 to 100; null only when classification failed.

intents.description: Detected intents: buy_intent, question, complaint, praise, comparison.

note.description: One sentence from the classifier explaining the score.

failed.description: true when the model could not score this post; it stays in the feed and is not billed.

classification.description: The classifier verdict; null while the post is still queued for classification.

assignee.description: Workspace member this mention is assigned to; null when unassigned.

snoozedUntil.description: Until when the mention stays out of the feed; null when not snoozed.

createdAt.description: When the match was recorded; the default feed order.

id.description: Person id (aut_...): the canonical account. An account merged into someone resolves to that person.

platform.description: Platform of the canonical account; `accounts` lists every account.

name.description: Display name as of their newest post; null when the platform has none.

handle.description: Platform handle of the canonical account, formatted as the platform shows it.

url.description: Profile URL of the canonical account.

id.description: The account id (aut_...); the canonical one equals the person id.

platform.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin.

name.description: Display name as the platform reports it.

handle.description: Platform handle derived from the profile URL, formatted as the platform shows it.

accounts.description: Every account this workspace treats as this person, the canonical one first.

reach.description: Platform counts as of their newest post; null where the platform has no such number.

email.description: Only when the person made it public on the platform.

links.description: Other accounts the person lists on their profile.

profile.description: Public profile facts; null until looked up.

mentions.description: Every match of theirs for this workspace, relevant or not.

muted.description: Their posts stay out of the feed and every channel; ingest and billing are untouched.

annotations.description: What this workspace wrote about the person.

id.description: User id of the workspace member.

owner.description: The teammate who owns the contact; null when nobody does, or the owner left the workspace.

stage.description: Where your workspace stands with the person: not_contacted, contacted, replied, in_talks, customer or not_a_fit.

lastContactedAt.description: The newest logged activity; null when nobody logged a contact.

outreach.description: Where your workspace stands with the person. The first logged activity claims an unowned person for whoever reached out and moves not_contacted to contacted.

channel.description: How they were reached: email, x, linkedin, bluesky, reddit, github, call, meeting or other.

note.description: What was sent or said, briefly; empty when nothing was written.

id.description: User id of the workspace member.

member.description: Who reached out; null when an API key logged it without naming a member, or that member left the workspace.

get.description: The same mentions GET /v1/mentions would list for these filters, as CSV, newest matched first (the order they entered your feed, which can differ from the post date): id, published_at, platform, keyword, author, author_url, author_followers, relevance, sentiment, intents (pipe-separated), status, relevant, delivered, url, text (first 1,000 characters). Capped at 10,000 rows; the X-Mentions-Truncated header says when the cap cut the list. At most 6 exports per minute per workspace; a 429 carries Retry-After.
